propositions: Commit 330c normalizes checkbox state (case-insensitive, bullet-style-agnostic) to '[ ]' before hashing the material fingerprint so checkbox flips no longer invalidate plan-review attestations.
docs/plan-review-gate.md §Attestation, freshness & invalidation (L469) incorrectly implies any description edit including box flips invalidates attestations, contradicting the 330c behavior.
docs/plan-review-gate.md §AC-checkbox completeness precheck (L901) does not document that satisfying the precheck by checking boxes is attestation-safe and does not stale the review.

Documentation must clarify that only item-TEXT edits are material and invalidate attestations; checkbox-state normalization removes box-flip staleness across both plan-review close gate and completion-verifier staleness checks.
